violations.text: Employee with no beard guard/restraint while engaging in food preparation. Employee preparing food no beard guard.
Equipment and utensils not properly air-dried - wet nesting. Clean bins wet nesting on drying rack.

Employee touching ready-to-eat food with their bare hands - food was not being heated as a sole ingredient to 145 degrees F or immediately added to other ingredients to be cooked/heated to the minimum required temperature to allow bare hand contact. Establishment has no approved Alternative Operating Procedure. Employee touched warmed buns with bare hands. Educated employee.
